summary: Iteration 8 — End-to-end testing of (1) enriched /check slot shape with role-aware existing_leave, (2) public /r/{token} ExpiryBanner + Modern/Paper theme toggle persisted under 'grizedale_theme', (3) is.gd -> da.gd -> direct shortener chain with short_url_provider field, (4) direct 301 redirects (no preview page), (5) 3-state SlotBanner (red/amber/green) + submit stays enabled on conflicts, (6) Requests drawer renders 'via is.gd · expanded: ...' byline. ALL 7 NEW PYTEST PASS + ALL 10 REGRESSION PYTEST PASS + FULL FRONTEND FLOW VERIFIED.

issues: Still reads 'Phase 2 · v0.3.0' — carried over from iter_5/6/7; cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: _check_leave_slot correctly returns slot_status ∈ {open, role_conflict, hard_limit} with back-compat slot_open, and surfaces existing_leave for ALL leave on the date (not just role-clashes) so the amber FYI chip can render.
Existing_leave rows are hydrated with staff role via a single db.staff.find({initials: {$in: [...]}}) — good, no N+1.

_shorten_url chain is well-behaved: 5s timeout, follow_redirects=False on the create call, returns ('direct', None) on complete failure, logs at WARNING. is.gd first is correct — smaller tokens and no confirmation page.
POST /api/request-tokens stores short_url_provider on the doc so it's available in GET /api/request-tokens (list_tokens), enabling the 'via <provider>' byline to survive page reloads.
Public /check still honours preference=WANT_D/WANT_N by returning slot_status='open' with existing_leave populated — good, prevents false-positive blocking on working-shift preferences.
Manager-side PATCH /requests/{id} still uses conflict.get('slot_open') back-compat key — no regression on existing conflict dialog flow.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (theme toggle persistence, expiry banner, role-clash red banner + submit enabled, FYI amber chip with different-role staff listed, green clean-slot banner, public submit 200, Requests drawer 'via is.gd · expanded: ...' byline)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral AL rows for D.A./T.D./Night-Support staff on future dates (+200/+203/+206 days) created then cleaned up per-test. Several request-tokens created and revoked post-test. One staff_link request was submitted via the public page to verify submit flow (pending, remains in DB — not cleaned; same approach as iter_7 audit rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public_url> python -m pytest tests/test_phase4_slot_shortener.py -v. Covers TestSlotCheck (role_conflict / open+fyi / clean / self-hard-limit) and TestShortener (provider field / 301 direct redirect / valid_until back-compat). Test observed provider='is.gd' live in UK region. Short URL 301 redirect test SKIPs gracefully if both providers are unreachable (provider='direct'). Legacy tokens from before the migration still render in the drawer with 'via shortener' fallback — verified by spotting a tinyurl.com/... token in the drawer that renders without error.
